taste.name: Working specimen over marketing frame
taste.decision: Chose a live, centered interaction specimen over decorative product imagery
taste.reason: Builders need to judge state changes and density before they need persuasion

taste.name: Boundaries over floating layers
taste.trigger: When separating dense controls and data
taste.decision: Chose cool hairline rings and surface shifts over broad drop shadows
taste.reason: A flat tool surface lets state and content carry attention without making every control feel raised

taste.name: Compact comparison rhythm
taste.trigger: When fitting many component states into one catalogue
taste.decision: Chose an 11.5–13px interface scale on a 2px spacing base over large editorial type and wide pauses
taste.reason: People can compare more states without losing the label-to-control relationship

taste.name: One cool signal
taste.trigger: When emphasis is needed across tools, status, and navigation
taste.decision: Chose one blue accent used on a small share of the surface over a multi-accent brand palette
taste.reason: A single signal remains meaningful when semantic green, orange, and red are already reserved for outcomes
evidence: accent absent from large background areas
